profile: SQLite 3.47.2 under the ordinary rowid table declaration profile of sqlite-create-table-v1.json.
scope: One optional literal default per ordinary column with or without the existing default NOT NULL policy. Shape the declared SQLite value and preserve its assignment to that column.
structure: A column has name, declared type, nullability and an optional immutable scalar literal. An absent operand is distinct from an explicit SQL NULL operand.
conditions: One checked default and at most one admitted nullability constraint for each column.
The column default belongs to the closed literal union and has no table or parameter operands.
The completed table checks total scalar payload size and its existing target and column constraints.
Analysis accepts numeric signs on numeric literals, plain NULL, TEXT and BLOB, parenthesized single supported literals and decoded word defaults.
meaning: A missing value on INSERT takes the declared default or SQL NULL when no default exists. The table applies the declared affinity and nullability constraints. An explicitly supplied value bypasses the default. A default on a guarded creation attempt cannot alter the column of an already existing table.
sql: Append the DEFAULT keyword and typed literal to the owning column when present. Literal numeric, string, NULL and binary forms come from the checked structural operands.
observations: Absolute creation target, ordered names, declared types, nullability and default presence in the catalog
Typed rows from omitting the value, explicitly overriding the value and attempting an explicitly supplied SQL NULL
Exact constraint rejection under NOT NULL and restoration after the fixture savepoint
Both raw catalog records and the semantic projection of default presence are recorded. Catalog display spelling is governed by the fit between the default literal and its native expression rules.

finite.completeness: Check each observed schema, type, default alternative, nullability and creation guard identity exactly once.

exploration.structure: Vary ordered columns, target schema, declared affinity, nullability, decoded labels and explicit defaults, including absent operands and typed default values.

negative: Unsupported constant expression beyond one literal
An unsupported CHECK constraint with a default
Non-numeric literal with an explicit sign
faults: Replace each admitted default with NULL
Emit a BLOB default as a text value
open: Constant expression defaults with operators or functions, CURRENT_TIME-family defaults, CHECK constraints and signed nonnumeric forms
trust: Independent assignment model for the fixed storage values
Pinned SQLite catalog and write observations
The schema belongs to the same SQLite evaluation context
changeFromV1: The previous REPLACE with DEFAULT 1 negative is now a required positive of sqlite-not-null-conflict-v1.json. A CHECK constraint with a literal default tests refusal of a still unadmitted owning constraint. All finite products, exploration provisions and observations are retained.
observationRevision: Preserve the finite, exploration and negative budgets. The previously rejected simple unnamed CHECK is an analyzed positive in sqlite-implicit-checks-v1.json. Require the corresponding unsupported comment presentation to be rejected at the same construction boundary.
